biography: Leah is a Principal at CoreWeave, holding the highest individual contributor position. She has a strong background in energy strategy, site selection, utility engagement, and educating non-energy professionals on power strategies. Leah has been instrumental in building out the energy team at CoreWeave, encompassing middle office, policy, and site/market development teams. Her experience includes 15 years in site selection for generation at Pattern Energy and 1 year in site selection for load and utility engagement at CoreWeave. She is seeking a role with greater team ownership and a better work-life balance.
